GraphQL.description: Configures the GraphQL API, including the limits used to protect the server against malicious queries. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Apis:GraphQL'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Apis.GraphQL/.

ExposeExceptions.description: Whether exception details such as stack traces are exposed to GraphQL clients. Defaults to true in the Development environment and to false otherwise.

MaxDepth.description: The maximum total nesting depth allowed across all the queries of a request.

MaxComplexity.description: The maximum complexity allowed for a query. When not set, the query complexity is not limited.

FieldImpact.description: The average impact of a field, used to compute the complexity of a query. When not set, the default impact of the GraphQL library is used.

DefaultNumberOfResults.description: The default number of results returned by all paged fields and types.

MaxNumberOfResults.description: The maximum number of results returned by all paged fields and types.

MaxNumberOfResultsValidationMode.description: The behavior when a pager parameter exceeds 'MaxNumberOfResults'. 'Enabled' raises a GraphQL validation error. 'Disabled' logs the information and only returns the maximum number of results. 'Default' behaves as 'Enabled' in the Development environment and as 'Disabled' otherwise.

OrchardCore_Apis_GraphQL.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Apis_GraphQL' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Apis:GraphQL' instead.
